gallery.about.body:
*Discover Glass Art* is a Museum With No Frontiers (MWNF) project, set up in cooperation with Partners from all around the world. It invites visitors to explore the use of glass in different cultures, countries, and periods, and to become aware of the universal language of glass art across civilisations. Unlike existing glass collections, *Discover Glass Art* is a multinational resource providing access to material from a variety of institutions in many different countries. Database entries are compiled by curators of the contributing institution and follow standardised editorial criteria.  
  
The Database includes items made of glass and glass-related items contributed by our Partners specifically for the *Discover Glass Art* project as well as glass items that are a part of other projects within the MWNF Database.  
  
We suggest you start your visit in the [Collection](https://glass.museumwnf.org/collection), where a range of filters offers a great variety of options to explore the material in the Database. For research, you can use the **Search** bar, located on the top right of the page. If you are interested in learning about the contribution from a specific institution, the [Partner](https://glass.museumwnf.org/partners) section might be the best place to start. In the [Timeline](https://glass.museumwnf.org/timeline) you will find countries’ historical context information and [My Collection](https://www.museumwnf.org/mycollection/index.php) lets you add any item from this project to your personal collection.  
  
*Discover Glass Art* is a work-in-progress and we invite you to return from time to time to discover the latest entries in the Database.
